newsitem.title: THAILAND: Amsteel unit wins approval for Thai office.
newsitem.headline: Amsteel unit wins approval for Thai office.

text.p: Amsteel Securities, a unit of Malaysia's Amsteel Bhd, has received approval from Securities Exchange Commission to open a representative office in Thailand, a company official said on Thursday.
New Amsteel Securities Chief Representative Officer Pisamai Skuliatama told Reuters the securities office was likely to be opened before the end of October.
Amsteel Bhd is owned by Malaysia's Lion Group.
Pisamai said negotiations were underway with an unnamed local firm through which orders from Amsteel Securities extensive overseas operations could be channeled.
Amsteel had been planning its move into Thailand since last year and it has also applied to set up an insurance company called Amsteel Life Insurance.
Pisamai said Amsteel Securities has operations in London, Jakarta, Hong Kong, the Philippines and Malaysia. Offices are also planned for New York, Singapore and Shanghai.
